# Langtuo Valve - Industrial Valve Manufacturer

> Langtuo Valve (Shenzhen Langtuo Valve Co., Ltd) is a Chinese industrial valve manufacturer and exporter in Shenzhen, China, established in 2009. We supply ball, gate, globe, butterfly, check, control and thermal-oil valves with manual, pneumatic and electric actuation. 50+ product models, GB/API/ANSI/DIN standards, OEM/ODM support, export to 30+ countries including Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines, Russia, Saudi Arabia and UAE. Contact: LTVALVE1@126.com

## Valve Products
- [Ball Ball](https://www.langtuovalve.com/ball-valve.html): Ball valves for on/off and throttling service, manual and actuated.
- [Gate Gate](https://www.langtuovalve.com/gate-valve.html): Gate valves for full-bore isolation in water, oil and gas lines.
- [Globe Globe](https://www.langtuovalve.com/globe-valve.html): Globe valves for flow control and throttling applications.
- [Butterfly Butterfly](https://www.langtuovalve.com/butterfly-valve.html): Butterfly valves, wafer and lug types, with actuation options.
- [Check Check](https://www.langtuovalve.com/check-valve.html): Check valves to prevent backflow in pipelines.
- [Control Control](https://www.langtuovalve.com/control-valve.html): Control valves with pneumatic or electric actuators for process automation.
- [Angle Angle](https://www.langtuovalve.com/angle-valve.html): Angle valves for space-saving piping layouts.
- [Flush Flush](https://www.langtuovalve.com/flush-bottom-valve.html): Flush bottom valves for tank drainage in process industries.
- [Steam Steam](https://www.langtuovalve.com/steam-trap.html): Steam traps for condensate removal and energy saving.
- [Pipe Strainer.Html](https://www.langtuovalve.com/strainer.html): Pipe strainers to protect pumps, meters and valves.
- [Thermal Thermal](https://www.langtuovalve.com/thermal-oil-valve.html): Thermal oil valves for high-temperature heat transfer systems.
